## About
Ward Auto Body has been a landmark in the village of River Grove for a long time. The shop was originally owned and operated by Tex Ward, and our family has kept a body shop running at this same spot on Grand Avenue ever since.
We are family-owned and operated, so a friendly atmosphere and quality work come first. Our goal is to bring your vehicle back to pre-accident condition, using Chief frame alignment racks and a Garmat downdraft spray booth that bakes your finish just like at the factory.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 61 Google reviews. Come see us about a quarter mile west of River Road on Grand Ave.

## Services
- Collision repair: Collision repair on everything from imported sports cars to motorhomes, restored to pre-accident condition.
- Fleet trucks and buses: Our facility is equipped for personal vehicles as well as fleet trucks and buses.
- Frame alignment and spray booth: Our shop has Chief frame alignment racks and a Garmat downdraft spray booth.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Pull under our carport on Grand Avenue and we will give you a fast, friendly estimate.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at the corner of Elm Street and Grand Avenue, a short way west of River Road on Grand Ave. Elm Street is one-way northbound.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we offer auto repair financing options. Give us a call to learn more.
